title: Diagnostic Review: Distributed Data Parallelism Deadlock & Collective Barrier Race
description: Inspect a multi-GPU PyTorch DDP training script for rank-conditional collective communication deadlocks, uncoordinated barrier checkpoint racing, and unscaled learning rates.

artifact.content:
import os
import torch
import torch.distributed as dist
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.nn.parallel import DistributedDataParallel as DDP

def setup_distributed_training(local_rank: int, world_size: int):
    torch.cuda.set_device(local_rank)
    dist.init_process_group(backend="nccl", init_method="env://")
    model = nn.Linear(512, 10).to(local_rank)
    ddp_model = DDP(model, device_ids=[local_rank])
    
    # Fixed learning rate regardless of world size causes divergence as batch size scales
    base_lr = 1e-4
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(ddp_model.parameters(), lr=base_lr)
    return ddp_model, optimizer

def train_step(rank: int, ddp_model: nn.Module, batch_data: torch.Tensor, optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer):
    output = ddp_model(batch_data)
    loss = output.sum()
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()
    
    # Placing collective all_reduce in rank-conditional branch deadlocks all other ranks
    if rank == 0:
        dist.all_reduce(loss, op=dist.ReduceOp.SUM)
        print(f"Master reduced loss: {loss.item()}")

def save_model_checkpoint(rank: int, model: nn.Module, epoch: int, path: str):
    # Rank 0 writes checkpoint without synchronization barrier, racing with rank 1..N reads
    if rank == 0:
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), path)
    # Missing dist.barrier() causes other ranks to proceed before disk write finishes

defects.title: Unscaled Learning Rate Across Distributed World Size
defects.consequence: Keeping learning rate constant while effective batch size scales 8x across GPUs causes gradient variance mismatch and loss divergence.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Scale learning rate linearly or via square root with world size (e.g. lr = base_lr * world_size) and introduce warmup schedule.

defects.title: Asymmetric Collective Communication in Conditional Branch
defects.consequence: Calling all_reduce only on rank 0 causes all other GPU worker ranks to hang perpetually waiting for rank 0 in collective NCCL ring.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: All participating ranks in the process group must invoke collective communication operations unconditionally.

defects.title: Missing Distributed Barrier Synchronization Around Checkpoint Save
defects.consequence: Non-master ranks proceed immediately to downstream evaluation while rank 0 is still flushing state to disk, causing file read corruption.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Insert dist.barrier() after rank 0 save operation to ensure all ranks wait until checkpoint write is complete.
